title: Weaning of Isaac; Ishmael sent away
summary: Abraham holds a feast when Isaac is weaned; Hagar and Ishmael are sent away (Gen 21:8-21).
description: At the weaning feast Sarah saw Ishmael mocking (Gen 21:9; Gal 4:29). Jones and CFAH count the 400 years of Gen 15:13 from here ("Isaac established as the Seed lineage").

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones baseline): 1891 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 1: Problem, Data, and Methodology," ARJ 15 (2022): 377–390, section "Our Assumptions (Declared Biases)", Table 1 "Biblically derived dates from Ussher and Jones"
chronologies.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point.
